The new snapshot conversion handles ordinary networks, but `_model_snapshot_array` assumes every efficiency DataFrame has a single-level component-name column index. In stochastic networks, dynamic efficiencies can have `(scenario, name)` MultiIndex columns; calling `values.columns.rename("name")` fails rather than constructing the efficiency array at the flow’s snapshot labels. Thus the requirement does not hold for every network.
